sentences.japanese: ベンは給仕がスープを膝にこぼしたときの様子をまねて見せた。
sentences.english: Ben acted out the scene of the waitress spilling soup in his lap.

sentences.japanese: ナンシーは膝の上に両肘をついた。
sentences.english: Nancy put her elbows on her knees.

sentences.japanese: その痩せた男は膝を曲げて日陰で少し休んだ。
sentences.english: The thin man paused in the shade with his knees a little bent.

sentences.japanese: その子供は、つまずいて転んで膝を突いた。
sentences.english: The kid stumbled and fell to his knees.

sentences.japanese: しかし君はあまり膝を曲げたくないでしょう。
sentences.english: But you don't want to bend the knees too much.
